About this restaurant

For Tassili, dining is part of the guided expedition. A camp cook and simple meals are more realistic than a restaurant listing in the rock-art zones. Simple expedition meals, bread, tea, and camp cooking support the journey; water, dietary needs, and food storage are safety-critical logistics.

Signature dish

Camp meals, tea, couscous, and simple desert expedition food

Practical information

Verify food, water, permits, guide support, and emergency planning with the operator before departure. Verify the current menu, prices, opening hours, reservation policy, dietary support, and whether non-resident diners are accepted before travel.

Nearby attraction

This restaurant is recommended for travelers visiting Djanet & Tassili n’Ajjer.

What to verify before planning this meal

  • Current opening hours, reservation rules, and seasonal closures.
  • Menu availability, dietary needs, and whether drinks or service are extra.
  • Whether the venue is lodge-only, guest-only, or open to outside diners.
  • Transfer time after dark, parking, boat access, tides, or road conditions.
  • Meal timing around game drives, trekking starts, tours, or ferry crossings.
  • Final price tier, taxes, and payment methods accepted.

Editorial research reviewed July 13, 2026. Confirm live hours, menus, prices, access, dietary support, and reservation terms directly with the venue.
